# Service Status

The liveness status of an online service — a VALUE vocabulary (live, shut-down, …); open set.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ServiceStatus`](gmeow-ServiceStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for a service's liveness — the open set of statuses (live, shut down, …) an [`OnlineService`](gmeow-OnlineService.md) declares through [`gmeow:serviceStatus`](../properties/gmeow-serviceStatus.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an account's usage state (use [`gmeow:AccountStatus`](gmeow-AccountStatus.md)) and avoid minting per-status subclasses; statuses are individuals on an open value vocabulary.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded [`gmeow:ServiceStatus`](gmeow-ServiceStatus.md) individuals from a service via [`gmeow:serviceStatus`](../properties/gmeow-serviceStatus.md), and pair the shut-down value with [`gmeow:serviceShutdownDate`](../properties/gmeow-serviceShutdownDate.md); extend the set with new individuals rather than subclasses.

### Examples

- ex:serviceStatusLive a [`gmeow:ServiceStatus`](gmeow-ServiceStatus.md).
